text: ポケモン　そだてる　にも　ポリシーが　ある　やつ　だけが　プロに　なれるの！

structure.jp: ポケモン　そだてる　にも
ポリシーが　ある　やつ　だけが
structure.en: only people who have a policy

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモン　そだてる　にも　ポリシーが　ある　やつ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in an action word placed right before a thing or person describes it. ポリシーが　ある　やつ = 'a person who has a policy'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after a plain action word means 'for doing' it, and も adds 'even'. そだてる　にも = 'even for raising them'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing なる to なれる adds the meaning 'can'. プロに　なれる = 'can become a pro'.
